body:
Hi there. I cannot figure out how to configure the `searchBox` widget to use existing `input` element in [the docs](https://www.algolia.com/doc/api-reference/widgets/search-box/js/). Can anyone suggest?

I guess this does not anymore because the widget renders own markup inside my `input` as of version 4.8.7:

![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/6065071/109018007-4ceda680-76ea-11eb-9868-f1e596e2636b.png)
